data.one_liner: Library providing Unicode character utilities and emoji data generated from Unicode 17.0.0
data.what_it_does: It offers functions to convert characters to runes, check character categories, get Unicode blocks, and work with emoji names, code points, and decompositions. The data is auto‑generated, so it stays up to date with the Unicode standard.
use_when: You need to inspect or classify Unicode characters in Dart code.
You want to look up emojis by name or filter them by status.
You need quick access to Unicode blocks or character properties without external APIs.
avoid_when: You only need a small subset of Unicode data and want to avoid the large generated files.
You are building a minimal, highly optimized binary and can afford to write custom logic instead of pulling in a full Unicode database.
strengths: Zero runtime dependencies beyond Dart core and small packages.
Fast lookups for emoji by name and category.
Includes utilities for character case conversion and block detection.
weaknesses: Large generated source files increase package size.
No support for custom or extended emoji sets beyond Unicode.
Requires keeping the package updated manually to stay current with new Unicode releases.
